chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us, from al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ismail b. Muslim al-Sukuni, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The pressure of the grave for the believer is an expiation for any wasted blessings of his.

key_terms.تضييع النعم: Wasting of blessings -- failure to appreciate and properly use the blessings God has granted
key_terms.ضغطة القبر: Pressure of the grave -- a constriction experienced by the dead in their graves as part of the afterlife experience
key_terms.كفارة: Expiation/atonement -- compensation that removes the burden of sin

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the pressure of the grave for believers in Islam?
ai.summary: This prophetic hadith, narrated through the chain of Imams back to Imam Ali (AS), conveys a teaching from the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) about the purpose of the grave's pressure on believers. The squeezing of the grave serves as a divine expiation and purification for the believer's failure to appreciate and properly use God's blessings during their lifetime. This reflects the Shia understanding that trials in the barzakh (intermediate realm) can serve as purification rather than punishment.
